title: Gazrapse
bio:
Auditory Cultures w/ Gazrapse

*Monthly*

Gazrapse is an audio engineer and sound researcher from Monterrey, Mexico. His main interest is to manipulate sound via electronic and acoustic processes mixed with an ongoing exploration on sound studies. His musical output includes grime, atmospheric jungle and mineral ambient with releases on record labels as Snu (MX) and Corrupt Data (UK). His artistic practice has been featured in group exhibitions in Mexico, Denmark, Germany and Taiwan. He also runs an independent cultural space called "Memoria Local" in Monterrey focused on audio culture and native history along with two other audio and video engineers.
